pins.exact_text: | `DAC-FR-001` | Git treeのexact HEADから対象artifactを列挙し、working treeや未追跡fileを正本inventoryへ混ぜない。 |
| `DAC-FR-002` | artifact classとlifecycle dispositionを別軸で管理し、classごとに必要bindingを変える。 |
| `DAC-FR-003` | authority bindingの参照先を再帰検査し、存在するが失効・互換・履歴化したtargetへのcurrent edgeを拒否する。 |
| `DAC-NFR-002` | compatibility、historical、referenceの存在を欠陥扱いせず、active decision利用だけを拒否する。 |
| `DAC-NFR-003` | 全Markdownへ同じmetadataやRequirement IDを一律要求しない。 |

pins.exception_or_detail: path alone cannot infer class; class-specific schema/catalog/frontmatter/owner registry; conflict is ambiguous and rejected
do not trust self-claim; exact join to current authority index, candidate registry, archive boundary and generation provenance
recursive disposition/epoch/owner/digest validation; reject cycle, dangling and dead authority

input_policy is distinct from lifecycle; selected temporary/migration/compatibility/historical input needs owner, expiry or retirement condition, and consumer scope; do not promote to current authority/output or infer missing facts

legacy_sources.metadata_applicability: L3 separates class-specific schema and input_policy; it does not impose identical metadata on every Markdown file.

pins.negative: untracked or dirty-working-tree-only file does not enter exact HEAD inventory
tracked blob content change changes artifact digest and inventory revision
path and catalog class conflict fails closed as ambiguous
historical frontmatter self-claim cannot promote to current authority
current document edge to an existing compatibility target is rejected as dead authority
cycle and dangling target produce distinct findings
old historical document without consumers is not misclassified as high severity or deletion request
startup-reachable candidate read as current is rejected at P0
temporary input missing owner, expiry or retirement condition cannot become current input
expired temporary/migration input from active consumer stays UNKNOWN or typed-expired finding; no current authority edge
temporary/compatibility/historical input projected as current authority/output is rejected, not offset by legacy success

None specifies this census's tracked exact-HEAD inventory, class-specific authority resolver/binding schema, recursive dead-authority edge scanner, or metadata-applicability rules.

condition_comparison.covered_adjacent: OS-015 tracks target/source identity, revision and digest; HARNESS-010/011 fix pack revision/inputs and call boundary.
condition_comparison.uncovered: No adopted L2/L11 requires census enumeration from tracked exact HEAD or exclusion of working-tree/untracked files, nor the AC-002 digest/inventory revision oracle.
condition_comparison.negative_scope: Do not infer an exact-HEAD scanner or complete inventory from provenance, pack inputs, or source-read boundaries.

condition_comparison.covered_adjacent: OS-015 records source/authority/projection; HARNESS-010 distinguishes pack identity, version, dependencies, scope and owner.
condition_comparison.uncovered: No adopted pair supplies the DAC class resolver, separate artifact-class/lifecycle/input-policy schema, class-specific binding requirements, exact authority/catalog/provenance joins, ambiguity rejection, or frontmatter-self-claim negative oracle.
condition_comparison.negative_scope: Do not infer scanner class binding from generic pack identity or management metadata.

condition_comparison.covered_adjacent: OS-015 preserves authority provenance, revision/digest and unresolved conflicts; HARNESS-011 checks declared capability/contract/dependency versions for a selected call.
condition_comparison.uncovered: Fixed adopted pairs do not recursively inspect every authority binding target or reject current edges to owner-classified revoked, compatibility or historical targets; cycle/dangling/dead-authority oracles are absent.
condition_comparison.near_candidate: HELIXOS-L2-106/L11-106 addresses a selected, explicitly supplied binding/reference chain only. It excludes repository-wide census, added compatibility/expiry/history rules and unprovided targets; not closure or a formal successor.

condition_comparison.covered_adjacent: OS-015 distinguishes authority source and unresolved/stale cases; OS-110 later has a bounded nonfinding boundary for explicit compatibility/historical/reference artifacts without an active decision edge.
condition_comparison.uncovered: Fixed adopted L2/L11 does not establish that mere artifact existence is non-defective while active-decision use of those target classes is rejected. OS-110 does not add that rejection rule.
condition_comparison.negative_scope: No severity/deletion finding from existence alone; active decision edge remains the missing condition to evaluate.

condition_comparison.covered_adjacent: OS-015 records fields required by its own managed authority record; HARNESS-010/011 fields apply to the selected pack/call contract.
condition_comparison.uncovered: No fixed pair defines applicability of metadata or Requirement IDs by Markdown document class/consumer relation or tests that every Markdown need not share identical fields.
condition_comparison.negative_scope: Do not generalize OS-015 or HARNESS pack/call metadata into a universal Markdown rule.
